content.short: CardanoPress is a WordPress plugin for adding Cardano wallet, token, and dapp features to websites easily.
content.description: CardanoPress is a WordPress plugin designed to help site owners add Cardano blockchain features without heavy custom development. It gives builders a way to integrate wallet-aware experiences, dapp functionality, and Cardano-powered workflows into familiar WordPress sites. The project lowers the barrier for creators, communities, and businesses that want to connect websites with Cardano while still using the content-management tools they already know. Its role is practical Web3 integration for WordPress.
content.meta: CardanoPress helps WordPress sites add Cardano wallet, token, and dapp features easily. Explore CardanoPress on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
